SDSB1.label: Access blocked by security/network controls

SDSB1.1.label: Content Protection - Cloudflare Firewall rules
SDSB1.1.description: Definition: Use when Elsevier or Cloudflare explicitly blocks traffic, an IP address or suspicious activity.

SDSB1.2.label: Browser compatibility issues
SDSB1.2.description: Definition: Use when the apparent security block occurs only with a specific browser or device.

SDSB1.3.label: Not enough info
SDSB1.3.description: Definition: Use when a security or network block is reported but its cause is unclear.

SDSB1.4.label: Raven email blocklist
SDSB1.4.description: Definition: Use when Raven blocks the user’s email address or email domain.

SDSB1.5.label: Other
SDSB1.5.description: Definition: Use for another confirmed security or network restriction not listed above.

SDSB1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified as 'Access blocked by security/network controls'. Choose the root cause from this group only. That contact reason means: Use when access is explicitly denied by a security or network control, with signals such as “access denied”, IP blocked, Cloudflare, firewall, unusual downloading or crawling, and do not use for subscription, entitlement or sign-in problems.
